findings: Header still risks horizontal scroll on 375px — The header contains 7 visible controls (search, notifications, language, network, demo role, login, register); while some are hidden via breakpoints, the remaining elements may exceed 375px width. Verify via browser dev tools at 375px that no horizontal scroll appears.

Account tabs need better mobile UX — The horizontal scrollable tab bar with 12 tabs works but requires users to scroll to find tabs. Consider scroll snap, tab carousel with dots, or collapsible sections to improve discoverability.

Auto-translate race condition on rapid field switches — If user changes English title then immediately changes Arabic title before 300ms debounce fires, the pending English→Arabic translation may overwrite the Arabic edit. Add check to prevent translation if target field was manually edited within last 500ms.

MediaUploader grab cursor not explicitly styled — The active:cursor-grabbing class relies on Tailwind/CSS support; verify grab cursor appears on hover and grabbing cursor during drag. If not visible, add inline cursor style.

Card heights inconsistent between grid and list layouts — Grid uses aspect-[4/3] for uniformity, list uses min-h-[120px] allowing variable heights. While intentional for layout fit, creates visual inconsistency; consider applying aspect-ratio to list layout or document as intentional.

Footer safe-area padding not verified on notched devices — Bottom nav uses pb-safe and safe-area-inset-bottom for notches/home indicators, but real device testing on iOS/Android is not confirmed. Verify footer + bottom nav spacing on actual devices with safe-area insets.
